passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families, men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
The LORD gave them instructions.
The Kohathites are a group within the Levites.
The LORD told Moses and Aaron to count the Kohathites.
They must count them by their clans and by their families.
They must count every man from thirty years old to fifty years old.
These men are able to serve.
They are able to do the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֙ בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ בָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
passages.sermon: The Kohathites are a clan among the Levites.\r\nThey have a special duty at the Tent of Meeting.\r\nTheir service concerns the most holy things.
passages.original: זֹ֛את עֲבֹדַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
His sons served as priests with him.
The Israelites lived in a camp in the wilderness.
The ark of the Testimony was a holy object.
The ark was kept inside the Tent of Meeting.
A special curtain called the veil separated the ark from the people.
When the Israelites prepared to travel, the camp set out.
At that time, Aaron and his sons went into the Tent of Meeting.
They took down the veil of the curtain.
They used the veil to cover the ark of the Testimony.
passages.original: וּבָ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהוֹרִ֕דוּ אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֑ךְ וְכִ֨סּוּ־ בָ֔הּ אֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃

passages.text: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
passages.sermon:
Aaron and his sons serve as priests.
They work in the Tent of Meeting.
They handle the most holy things.
They cover the ark of the Testimony.
They place a covering of fine leather over the ark.
They spread a solid blue cloth over the leather covering.
They insert the poles into the ark.
passages.original: וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּסוּי֙ ע֣וֹר תַּ֔חַשׁ וּפָרְשׂ֧וּ בֶֽגֶד־ כְּלִ֛יל תְּכֵ֖לֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂמ֖וּ בַּדָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
passages.sermon:
Aaron and his sons serve as priests.
They care for the holy things in the Tabernacle.
They must prepare the table of the Presence when the camp moves.
They spread a blue cloth over the table of the Presence.
They place the plates on the table.
They place the cups on the table.
They place the bowls on the table.
They place the pitchers for the drink offering on the table.
They leave the regular bread offering on the table.
The bread must always remain on the table.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ שֻׁלְחַ֣ן הַפָּנִ֗ים יִפְרְשׂוּ֮ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵלֶת֒ וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶת־ הַקְּעָרֹ֤ת וְאֶת־ הַכַּפֹּת֙ וְאֶת־ הַמְּנַקִּיֹּ֔ת וְאֵ֖ת קְשׂ֣וֹת הַנָּ֑סֶךְ וְלֶ֥חֶם הַתָּמִ֖יד עָלָ֥יו יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
passages.sermon:
The priests serve in the Tabernacle.
They prepare the holy objects for transport.
They spread a scarlet cloth over the objects.
They cover the objects with a fine leather covering.
They insert the carrying poles into the objects.
passages.original: וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בֶּ֚גֶד תּוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־ בַּדָּֽיו׃

passages.text: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
passages.sermon:
The priests must take a blue cloth.
They must cover the lampstand for light with it.
They must also cover the lampstand’s lamps.
They must cover the lampstand’s wick trimmers.
They must cover the lampstand’s trays.
They must cover all the jars of oil for the lampstand.
The priests use these jars to serve the lampstand.
passages.original: וְלָקְח֣וּ׀ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֗לֶת וְכִסּ֞וּ אֶת־ מְנֹרַ֤ת הַמָּאוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ מַלְקָחֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־ מַחְתֹּתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י שַׁמְנָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְתוּ־ לָ֖הּ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
passages.sermon: The priests take the lampstand and all its utensils.\r\nThey place them inside a covering made of fine leather.\r\nThey put the covered lampstand and utensils on the carrying frame.
passages.original: וְנָתְנ֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלֶ֔יהָ אֶל־ מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־ הַמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
passages.sermon:
The priests must prepare the gold altar.
The gold altar stands in the sanctuary.
They must spread a blue cloth over the gold altar.
They must cover the gold altar with a fine leather covering.
They must insert the carrying poles into the gold altar.
passages.original: וְעַ֣ל׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֗ב יִפְרְשׂוּ֙ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֖וּ אֶת־ בַּדָּֽיו׃

passages.text: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
passages.sermon:
The Levites serve in the sanctuary.
They use special utensils for this service.
They must take all these utensils.
They must place the utensils in a blue cloth.
They must cover the utensils with fine leather.
They must put the utensils on the carrying frame.
passages.original: וְלָקְחוּ֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֨י הַשָּׁרֵ֜ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ־ בָ֣ם בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ וְנָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶל־ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְכִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם בְּמִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְנָתְנ֖וּ עַל־ הַמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it, and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
passages.sermon:
Aaron and his sons serve as priests in the sanctuary.
They must care for the bronze altar.
First, they remove the ashes from the altar.
Next, they spread a purple cloth over the altar.
They gather all the vessels used for serving at the altar.
These vessels include the firepans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls.
They place all these altar vessels on top of the altar.
They cover the altar and its vessels with a fine leather covering.
They insert the carrying poles into the altar.
passages.original: וְדִשְּׁנ֖וּ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֔יו בֶּ֖גֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן׃ וְנָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָיו אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֞יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְֽשָׁרְת֧וּ עָלָ֣יו בָּהֶ֗ם אֶת־ הַמַּחְתֹּ֤ת אֶת־ הַמִּזְלָגֹת֙ וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּפָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּס֛וּי ע֥וֹר תַּ֖חַשׁ וְשָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽיו׃

passages.text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest.
His sons are priests.
Aaron and his sons cover the holy objects.
They also cover all the holy equipment.
They do this when the camp is about to move.
After Aaron and his sons finish covering everything, the Kohathites come.
The Kohathites are a clan from the tribe of Levi.
The Kohathites carry the holy objects and equipment.
The Kohathites must not touch the holy objects.
If the Kohathites touch the holy objects, they will die.
The Kohathites are responsible for carrying these items in the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וְכִלָּ֣ה אַֽהֲרֹן־ וּ֠בָנָיו לְכַסֹּ֨ת אֶת־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּדֶשׁ֮ בִּנְסֹ֣עַ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן יָבֹ֤אוּ בְנֵי־ קְהָת֙ לָשֵׂ֔את וְלֹֽא־ יִגְּע֥וּ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵ֑תוּ אֵ֛לֶּה מַשָּׂ֥א בְנֵֽי־ קְהָ֖ת בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
passages.sermon:
Eleazar is the son of Aaron.
Aaron is the priest.
Eleazar is a priest.
Eleazar must oversee the oil for the lamp.
Eleazar must oversee the fragrant incense.
Eleazar must oversee the daily grain offering.
Eleazar must oversee the anointing oil.
Eleazar is responsible for the entire tabernacle.
Eleazar is responsible for everything in the tabernacle.
Eleazar is responsible for the holy objects in the tabernacle.
Eleazar is responsible for the utensils of the holy objects.
passages.original: וּפְקֻדַּ֞ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר׀ בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמָּאוֹר֙ וּקְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֔ים וּמִנְחַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה פְּקֻדַּ֗ת כָּל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֔וֹ בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Do not let the Kohathite clan be destroyed.
The Kohathites are one of the Levite families.
Do not let them be cut off from among the Levites.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ אַל־ תַּכְרִ֕יתוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י מִתּ֖וֹךְ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest.
His sons are priests.
The Kohathites are Levites.
The Kohathites must approach the most holy things.
God wants the Kohathites to live.
God does not want the Kohathites to die.
Aaron and his sons must go in first.
Aaron and his sons must assign each Kohathite his task.
Aaron and his sons must tell each Kohathite what to carry.
If Aaron and his sons do this, the Kohathites will live.
If Aaron and his sons do this, the Kohathites will not die when they come near the most holy things.
passages.original: וְזֹ֣את׀ עֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם וְחָיוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֔תוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ וְשָׂמ֣וּ אוֹתָ֗ם אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־ עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְאֶל־ מַשָּׂאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites are a clan among the Levites.
They must not enter to look at the holy objects.
They must not see the holy objects, even for a moment.
If they look at the holy objects, they will die.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ יָבֹ֧אוּ לִרְא֛וֹת כְּבַלַּ֥ע אֶת־ הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָמֵֽתוּ׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans, from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to count the Gershonites.
The Gershonites are a group of Levites.
Moses must count the Gershonites by their families.
Moses must count the Gershonites by their clans.
Moses must count every Gershonite who is thirty years old or older.
Moses must count every Gershonite who is younger than fifty years old.
Moses must count every Gershonite who is between thirty and fifty years old.
Moses must count every Gershonite who comes to serve.
These Gershonites serve at the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the place where the Israelites worship God.
The Gershonites work there as part of their duties.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת־ רֹ֛אשׁ בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן גַּם־ הֵ֑ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה עַ֛ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ הַבָּא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֥ד עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite clans have a special job.
They must work and carry certain items.
They must carry the curtains of the tabernacle.
They must carry the Tent of Meeting.
They must carry the covering that goes over the Tent of Meeting.
This covering is made of fine leather.
They must carry the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They must carry the curtains of the courtyard.
They must carry the curtain for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard.
This gate surrounds the tabernacle and the altar.
They must carry the ropes for these items.
They must carry all the equipment used for their service.
The Gershonites must do everything that needs to be done with these items.
passages.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י לַעֲבֹ֖ד וּלְמַשָּֽׂא׃ וְנָ֨שְׂא֜וּ אֶת־ יְרִיעֹ֤ת הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמִכְסֵ֛ה הַתַּ֥חַשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶ֨ת־ מָסַ֔ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ וְאֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר וְאֶת־ מָסַ֣ךְ׀ פֶּ֣תַח׀ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְעַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתְרֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֖י עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה לָהֶ֖ם וְעָבָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron has sons who serve as priests.
The Gershonites are a clan of Levites.
The Gershonites have work to do for the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron and his sons must direct all the work of the Gershonites.
Aaron and his sons must direct all the carrying duties of the Gershonites.
The Gershonites must do every task as Aaron and his sons command.
You must give the Gershonites their assignments.
You must tell them what they are responsible to carry.
passages.original: עַל־ פִּי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו תִּהְיֶ֗ה כָּל־ עֲבֹדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֔י לְכָל־ מַשָּׂאָ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּפְקַדְתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵהֶם֙ בְּמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַשָּׂאָֽם׃

passages.text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonite clans have a special service.
They serve at the Tent of Meeting.
Ithamar is the son of Aaron the priest.
Ithamar directs all their duties.
passages.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּמִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃פ

passages.text: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families, from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Merari are a group of Levites.
You must count the sons of Merari.
Count them by their clans.
Count them by their families.
Count every man from thirty years old to fifty years old.
Count each man who comes to serve.
They serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֥ם לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֖ם תִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה וְעַ֛ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקְדֵ֑ם כָּל־ הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases, and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
passages.sermon:
The Merarite clans served at the Tent of Meeting.
Their duty was to carry certain items.
They carried the frames of the tabernacle.
They carried the crossbars of the tabernacle.
They carried the posts of the tabernacle.
They carried the bases of the tabernacle.
They carried the posts of the courtyard around the tabernacle.
They carried the bases of the courtyard posts.
They carried the tent pegs.
They carried the ropes.
They carried all the equipment for these items.
They carried everything needed for their use.
You must assign each item by name.
Each person must know which item he is responsible to carry.
passages.original: וְזֹאת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת מַשָּׂאָ֔ם לְכָל־ עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמּוּדָ֥יו וַאֲדָנָֽיו׃ וְעַמּוּדֵי֩ הֶחָצֵ֨ר סָבִ֜יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֗ם וִֽיתֵדֹתָם֙ וּמֵ֣יתְרֵיהֶ֔ם לְכָל־ כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑ם וּבְשֵׁמֹ֣ת תִּפְקְד֔וּ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת מַשָּׂאָֽם׃

passages.text: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.”
passages.sermon:
The Merarite clans are a group of Levites.
They have work to do at the Tent of Meeting.
Ithamar is the son of Aaron the priest.
Ithamar directs the Merarite clans in all their work at the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service assigned to the Merarite clans.
passages.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י לְכָל־ עֲבֹדָתָ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families, everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the brother of Moses.
The leaders of the congregation helped Moses and Aaron.
They counted the Kohathites.
The Kohathites were a clan of Levites.
They counted each family of the Kohathites.
They counted every man from thirty years old to fifty years old.
These men came to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
They came to do the work required there.
passages.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And those numbered by their clans totaled 2,750.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathite clans are a group of Levites.
Moses, Aaron, and the leaders counted the Kohathite clans.
They counted all men from thirty to fifty years old.
These men could serve at the Tent of Meeting.
The total number of the Kohathite clans was 2,750.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

passages.text: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a clan of Levites.
They served in the Tent of Meeting.
Moses and Aaron counted all the Kohathites who could serve.
They counted them as God commanded.
God gave His command through Moses.
passages.original: אֵ֤לֶּה פְקוּדֵי֙ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כָּל־ הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families, everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonites belonged to the tribe of Levi.
They had different clans and families.
Moses and Aaron counted the Gershonites.
They counted every man from thirty years old to fifty years old.
These men could serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Each man who was able came to do the work.
passages.original: וּפְקוּדֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
passages.sermon: The Gershonite men belonged to different clans and families.\r\nMoses and Aaron counted these men.\r\nThey counted 2,630 Gershonite men.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
passages.sermon:
The Gershonites were a clan of Levites.
They served at the Tent of Meeting.
Moses and Aaron counted them.
They counted them because the LORD commanded it.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֗י מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֔וֹן כָּל־ הָעֹבֵ֖ד בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families, everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were a clan of Levites.
Moses and Aaron counted the Merarites.
They counted them by their clans and by their families.
They counted only men from thirty years old to fifty years old.
These men came to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
They came to do the work there.
passages.original: וּפְקוּדֵ֕י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ הַבָּא֙ לַצָּבָ֔א לַעֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
passages.sermon: The Merarite men belonged to different clans.\r\nMoses and Aaron counted these men.\r\nThey registered 3,200 men in total.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were a clan of Levites.
Moses and Aaron counted the Merarite families.
They counted them because the LORD commanded it.
The LORD gave this command through Moses.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֔י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel counted the Levites.
They counted them by their clans and by their families.
They counted every Levite who was at least thirty years old.
They counted every Levite who was not yet fifty years old.
These Levites came to work.
They served in the Tent of Meeting.
They carried the items of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃ מִבֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל־ הַבָּ֗א לַעֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַעֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And the number of men was 8,580.
passages.sermon: Moses and Aaron counted the Levites.\r\nThey counted the men who were chosen to serve.\r\nThe total number was 8,580.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁמֹנַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: At the LORD’s command they were numbered through Moses and each one was assigned his work and burden, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses counted the Levites.
Moses counted each man.
Moses gave each man his work.
Moses gave each man his load to carry.
The LORD told Moses what to do.
Moses did everything the LORD commanded.
passages.original: עַל־ פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה פָּקַ֤ד אוֹתָם֙ בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל־ עֲבֹדָת֖וֹ וְעַל־ מַשָּׂא֑וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֕יו אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
